name: Hayasaki Ryoushirou
source: A famous soccer player, Ryoushirou's recent injury has forced him to rehabilitate at home. However, his time off the field takes a turn when his sisters discover the prank his teammates have played on him: stuffing his bag with erotic manga. With all four women now convinced he's an out-of-touch pervert, he is subject to their "solution" for him.
